Class CustomSpecies

java.lang.Object

ApisMellifera, AttaCephalotes, AustroplatypusIncompertus, BombusTerrestris, Camponotus, CamponotusPennsylvanicus, FormicaFusca, FormicaRufa, KladothripsHarteri, LasiusNiger, LinepithemaHumile, PolyergusRufescens, PseudoregmaBambucicola, ReticulitermesFlavipes, SmartAntSpecies, SoldierAntSpecies, SolenopsisInvicta, VespaCrabro, VespulaGermanica
